evidence.art: Painted stills and title are strong and cohesive: 000_title, 005_film, 013_film, 015_film have rich lighting and palette. The 3D walk set (021_walk_cut1, 048_walk) is good but its flat stylised characters clash with the painted film.
evidence.continuity: Film Anpu has a bare jackal head with a gold-checker collar and ankh in 013/015. Walk Anpu is a black-legged, small-headed 3D figure in 020/033 and reads as a different design. Sceptre colour is correct (dark bronze) and Ankhu's sandals are present in 020/046. However, Ankhu's kilt turns a pinkish, torn white in 028/031. The film also shows gold sandals and bright gold jewellery in 007/010.
evidence.cinematography_cuts: Film cuts are clean, with letterbox and good shot order (012 to 013 to 015). Walk hard cuts 021, 024, 030, 037, 040 are well framed. 021 is a strong gate frame. The cut at 037 jumps to a high-angle view where the group is small and hard to read. 046 and 047 end on the characters' backs with no emphasis.
evidence.motion_fx: Walk poses are varied across 025-028, but the 3D rigs are stiff. Legs are splayed and Anpu's black legs lack detail. There is no visible dust or foot FX anywhere. The film is static-looking in the frames, with only subtle parallax. Fades in 003/004 and 049 are smooth.
evidence.character_grounding: Shadows are present on the ground in 020, 027 and 037 and the feet mostly contact the stones. Scale is inconsistent: in 019 and 033 the figures are tiny against the set, and in 021 they are properly proportioned. In 030/031 the figures overlap and clip with the plinth, and Ankhu's body looks pasted. In 037/038 the attendant shadows detach from their feet.
evidence.game_feel: Handover from the film to the walk (018 to 019) is smooth. Torches and a lit road show the path in 019/020. Camera angles from 025 onward make it hard to see where to go. Characters shrink into the distance in 033-036. The pace is slow, with several near-duplicate frames (042-045 hold on static poses).
evidence.ui_title: Title logo in 000 is excellent: gilded serif, clear hierarchy, readable menu with an active diamond. Subtitles in 022-044 are clean serif but sit low and in 034 fade to low contrast over the stone. The end card in 046-048 is tidy.
evidence.audio_dialogue: Judged from subtitles and timing only, not heard. Lines in 022-044 are tonally strong and well-paced ('Walk with me, Ankhu'). The voiced exchange covers about 6 lines across the walk. I cannot verify mix or lip-sync. Subtitle cadence looks consistent.

defects.what: Ankhu's kilt is pink and torn-looking, and the figures overlap and clip, which makes the 3D characters read as pasted onto the painted set.
Film Anpu (bare jackal head, gold checker collar) does not match the walk Anpu (black legs, small head, different torso), and the gold jewellery conflicts with the bronze rule.
Walk characters have stiff, splayed gaits and no dust or foot FX, so the walk feels lifeless next to the painted film.
